tools.name: discond_find_discounts
tools.description: Search UAE merchants with live discounts on Discond by free text, place (emirate or area such as "Dubai Marina"), coordinates, discount provider, or category. Returns merchants with links; when the user is signed in to Discond it also returns their best current offers.

tools.name: discond_autocomplete_businesses
tools.description: Typo-tolerant autocomplete of UAE merchant names on Discond. Returns matching merchant ids and names for partial or misspelled input.

tools.name: discond_get_business
tools.description: Get one Discond merchant by id: name, categories, providers and link. When the user is signed in to Discond, its top live offers are included.

tools.name: discond_list_offers
tools.description: List live Discond offers, filtered by merchant, branch, provider, category, validity or online-only, sorted by newest, expiring or biggest discount. Has no place filter: filter by merchant id instead. Requires the user to be signed in to Discond.

tools.name: discond_get_offer
tools.description: Get one Discond offer by id: headline, terms, validity and redeem links. Requires the user to be signed in to Discond.

tools.name: discond_list_categories
tools.description: List Discond merchant categories with ids, optionally filtered by name.

tools.name: discond_list_providers
tools.description: List the discount providers Discond covers (for example Fazaa, The Entertainer, Talabat) with ids and offer counts, optionally filtered by name.

tools.name: discond_resolve_place
tools.description: Resolve a UAE place name to Discond place ids (emirate, community, settlement) or to a known area. A known area has level "area" and id 0; its name works as the place filter of discond_find_discounts.

name: discond_resolve_place
description: Resolve a UAE place name to Discond place ids (emirate, community, settlement) or to a known area. A known area or landmark (Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall…) has level "area" or "landmark" and id 0; its name works as the place filter of discond_find_discounts.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "discond_resolve_place" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
